answer: Mutual-Liability Pairing. Each new identity must be co-signed by an existing member who then shares any penalty the newcomer incurs, so a clone ring forces colluders to post real collateral per head. That liability makes each marginal clone strictly negative-EV: the attacker pays the full penalty plus the sponsor's forfeited bond, and the pairing signal travels through the graph faster than fake accounts can spread. Sponsors who accumulate too many dependents trip a gale of downstream exposure, and a widening ocean of unbacked accounts simply has no one willing to co-sign.
